name: appsignal
description: The AppSignal MCP server from pulsemcp/mcp-servers, vendored with a documented delta and hosted inside the strad bundle behind strad's own layer: injected credentials, one app per slug, read-only GraphQL. A tree in the strad bundle image.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && cp shared/src/graphql/schema.graphql shared/build/graphql/schema.graphql
scripts.test: npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
